qa_pairs.question: Which transmission mounting components apply to all BMW model types?
qa_pairs.answer: Cross member to body (1AZ) and rubber mounts to cross member or transmission (2AZ)

qa_pairs.question: What is the highest torque specification listed in the transmission mounts table?
qa_pairs.answer: 42 Nm for support tube to engine subframe on E36 models

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque values are specified for E36 transmission mounting components?
qa_pairs.answer: Two torque values: 42 Nm and 21 Nm
